metadata.description: Markdown converted to .docx and back keeps its contact details, its dates and the bulk of its text.
metadata.regression_of: Not a past incident but the shape of one. A one-way conversion can only be checked against what the author remembers the document said; a round trip can be checked against the document. The retains_fraction floor is deliberately 0.85 rather than 1.0 because whitespace normalisation and list-marker rewriting cost a few percent legitimately, while losing a section costs far more than that.
